name: wp-yahoo-intl-label-match
description: [PLUGIN BEHAVIOR] Search engines google/yahoo/yandex are matched by LABEL anywhere in the host ((^|\.)label\.), so search.yahoo.co.jp classifies organic. Engine matches 'yahoo.com' by suffix only.
quirk_decision: DISAGREEMENT: plugin -> organic (label match); engine -> referral ('search.yahoo.co.jp' does not end with 'yahoo.com').
